Class CausalProcessedStream<K,V>

java.lang.Object
io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalProcessedStream<K,V>
Type Parameters:
K - the forwarded key type
V - the forwarded value type
public final class CausalProcessedStream<K,V> extends Object
A causal stage bound to its processor, ready to declare sink(s) with to(String). Returned by CausalStream.process(ProcessorSupplier).

    • to

      public CausalProcessedStream<K,V> to(String topic)
      Declares a sink topic for this stage, deferring its key/value serdes to the runtime's default serdes (default.key.serde/default.value.serde). The sink's topology node name defaults to topic — use to(String, String) to name it explicitly, required when the stage forwards to more than one sink and the delegate targets one by name.
      Parameters:
      topic - the sink topic name
      Returns:
      this, for declaring further sinks or withPartitioner(StreamPartitioner)/withAudit(CausalAudit)

    • withPartitioner

      public CausalProcessedStream<K,V> withPartitioner(org.apache.kafka.streams.processor.StreamPartitioner<? super K, ? super V> partitioner)
      Sets the StreamPartitioner applied to every sink this stage declares (default: Kafka's own key-hash partitioner) — never configurable per-sink, so two sinks in the same stage can never drift onto different partitioners. A watermark carries a null value and reuses its triggering record's key, so partitioner must read only the key (never the value) — a coarser-than-key shard function is the intended use, not a value-based one, which cannot route a null-value watermark.
      Parameters:
      partitioner - the partitioner to apply uniformly to every sink; must read only the key
      Returns:
      this

    • withAudit

      public CausalProcessedStream<K,V> withAudit(CausalAudit audit)
      Registers a CausalAudit to receive this stage's per-record causal events, for routing to your own audit/compliance trail. Optional — without one, these events are observable only through Parsley's logs and metrics.
      Parameters:
      audit - the audit to notify; must not be null
      Returns:
      this
